source.title: Newry Reporter, 9 June 1949, p. 3 ("Mr. P. Agnew Defeated"); Armagh Guardian, 10 June 1949, p. 2; nominations from the Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1949, p. 5 ("Armagh City Contest"; "New Members"; "Old Members Come Back")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: both figures read from the Newry Reporter page image; 7 spoilt per the Irish Weekly, 11 June 1949, p. 6

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1949: nominations 17 May 1949; the only contest was Armagh City, polled 2 June 1949. The Armagh Guardian lists give no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Polled 2 June 1949. Agnew (Irish Labour Party) was the retiring member; Leyburn won by 261 on an 86.54 per cent poll (Armagh Guardian, 10 June 1949, p. 2).
